blocks.text: Festival notables from Cannes ( Minotaur ) to TIFF ( Elsinore ) to Sundance ( Josephine ) open in limited release with Paul Thomas Anderson ’s lates, concert doc Cameron Winter At Carnegie Hall . A24 expands Club Kid from limited release to about 228 theaters. Amazon MGM Studios takes I Play Rocky wide to 2,447 screens.

Mubi opens Cannes Grand Prix-winning thriller Minotaur by Andrey Zvyagintsev ( Loveless, Leviathan ) on three NYC screens (Angelika Film Center, Film at Lincoln Center) and the AMC Century City in LA. Stars Dmitriy Mazurov as Gleb, a corporate executive in 2022 Russia under siege on several fronts amidst the comfortable trappings of affluence and domesticity. Haunted at home by suspicion that his increasingly distant wife Galina (Iris Lebedeva) is unfaithful, and contending at work with a demand from local authorities to draft a quota of employees for the war in Ukraine, Gleb struggles to reassert control over his carefully ordered life.

blocks.text: At 97% Rotten Tomatoes Certified Fresh, see Deadline review . Nominated for three Gotham Awards (Best International Film, Best Director, Best Adapted Screenplay).

Sundance award-winner Josephine from Sumerian Pictures opens limited in New York (IFC Center, AMC Lincoln Square) and LA (AMC Burbank, AMC Century City) with numerous sold out screenings on both coasts this weekend and next ahead of a Dec. 4 expansion. The film directed by Beth de Araújo and starring Channing Tatum, Gemma Chan and newcomer Mason Reeves is 97% RT Certified Fresh, see Deadline review . Based on a experience by de Araújo as a child, the titular Josephine is an eight-year-old girl whose Sunday morning walk in the park with her father Damien ( Tatum ) turns tragic after they become momentarily separated and she witnesses a rape. Comforting the victim without understanding exactly what happened, she also becomes key to keeping the suspect behind bars and the harrowing event informs the rest of her life.

Winner of the Grand Jury Prize (Dramatic) and Audience Award (U.S. Dramatic) at Sundance with honors from Mill Valley, Montclair, Palm Springs and SCAD Savannah and Women in Film, Josephine has a trio of Gotham Award nominations (Best Feature; Outstanding Supporting Performance for Channing. Tatum; Breakthrough Performer for Mason Reeves).

Janus Films starts the rollout of Paul Thomas Anderson’s Cameron Winter At Carnegie Hall exclusively on 35mm. The film is embarking on a concert style tour, opening with limited evening showtimes in New York (Village East and BAM) and LA (Aero) before traveling around the country. Dozens of screenings have been sold out since the film’s New York Film Festival world premiere, filling some of the largest historic theaters in the country in San Francisco, Chicago, Boston, Vancouver, Toronto, Atlanta, Austin, Portland, Minneapolis and Raleigh. See Deadline’s review out of the London Film Festival .

blocks.text: Shot last December at the storied NYC venue, it marks Anderson’s first film after winning three Oscars at the 2026 Academy Awards for One Battle After Another (Best Picture, Best Director, Best Adapted Screenplay). Winter just received five Grammy nominations for his band Geese (Best New Artist, Best Alternative Music Album ( Getting Killed ), Best Rock Performance, and Best Rock Song (Trinidad), and Best Alternative Music Performance (Au Pays du Cocaine).

Simon Stone’s Elsinore from Focus Features debuts across six screens in NY and LA. Andrew Scott stars as Ian Charleson, capturing the Scottish-born actor’s extraordinary talent, struggles and triumphs. Supporting cast includes Olivia Colman, Billie Piper, Johnny Flynn, Peter Mullan and Joe Locke. The film world premiered at Telluride, won the International People’s Choice Award at Toronto, and was honored at fests from Hamptons, Mill Valley, San Diego, Chicago, Orcas Island and Heartland.
Scott earned a Gotham Award nomination for Outstanding Lead Performer and is set to receive the Desert Palm Achievement Actor Award at Palm Springs in January.
Elsinore , written by Stephen Beresford based on an idea by Ethan Silverman, sits At 88% RT Certified Fresh, Deadline review here .

Briarcliff Entertainment opens documentary Ash And Crayons by Evgeny Afineevsky at the Village East in NYC, expanding on 12/4. Since launching a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Russian leaders have targeted children with troops regularly accused of abducting minors and forcing them into adoptions or captivity to be re-educated as Russian patriots. Returning to the streets where he filmed his Oscar-nominated documentary Winter on Fire: Ukraine’s Fight for Freedom , and using a mix of live footage and animation, Afineevsky invites survivors to share their stories in a portrait of childhood resilience.

IFC Entertainment Group debuts Ken Sanzel’s action-thriller Best Pancakes In The County starring Nicolas Cage , Justin Long and Shelley Hennig on 34 screens. After a botched FBI heist, a cunning criminal returns to a remote small-town diner where rival assassins, rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past and a waitress with secrets collide in a deadly standoff over the course of one explosive night.
